Grid equipment makers expand capacity

Hitachi Energy said on Tuesday it would invest a further $250 million in its transformer factories, citing record orders from utilities. The company expects the new capacity to come online in 2028.

Shares of Siemens Energy AG (XETRA: ENR) rose after the group reported a larger-than-expected order backlog in its grid technologies division, which supplies transformers and switchgear.

Prysmian, the cable manufacturer listed in Milan, announced a contract to supply high-voltage cables for an offshore wind connection; the company said the order was worth about EUR 1.1 billion.

Premier, a regional distributor, was not mentioned by any of the analysts contacted for this article.
